question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word to complete the meaning of the sentence.**

The new owners of the newspaper had changed the ______ completely.
solution:
The correct answer is **"layout."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Layout** refers to the arrangement of elements on a page or in a space. (बग़ीचा, इमारत, लेख आदि के विभिन्न हिस्सों को व्यवस्थित करने का ढंग; नक़्शा, अभिन्यास)

 
 
• **Example**: *I like the **layout**__ of the house.*
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, the new owners of the newspaper changed the layout, or the way the newspaper was presented.
 
• This word choice makes sense given the context of a newspaper and the fact that the owners are making changes.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The new owners of the newspaper had changed the __**layout**__ completely. *

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Outlay** refers to the amount of money spent on something. (लागत, व्‍यय (विशेषतया कोई व्‍यापार या परियोजना आरंभ करने में लगी धनराशि))
 
• **Outlook **refers to a person's perspective or point of view. (दृष्टिकोण (जीवन और जगत के प्रति मनोवृत्ति या भावना))
 
• **Outlet **refers to a place where goods or services are sold. (सशक्त भावों, विचारों या ऊर्जा की अभिव्‍यक्ति और सदुपयोग का मार्ग)
